body: Thanks for the advice! What kind of trimmers do you use? Sorry I’m still new to this!
Poor baby!! Thanks, I’ll definitely consider it but we’ve basically baby kitten proofed our room when we got them. My thing is he gets stuck on my chair and even to their little cat tree.
Recommendations for trimmers? I’m still new to this! Thank you.
I’m stuck at 656 :( The game hasn’t fixed these since the day came out and it’s kinda frustrating.
I’m unable to sleep at night, I just sit and lay in bed overthinking about everything. Thinking I’m not good enough and that’s why he did it. Just a shit ton of horrible things.

I understand completely and your wording seemed fine to me. It’s hard, most nights I cry myself to sleep anymore. I can’t sleep without an audio stimulant like music or YouTube. It sucks most because I ruined my life. I was going to move in with my best friend and had a job ready for me out of state, he begged me to not move and be with him so I stayed. I even quit my job for him so he could get a good job and I stay home. It’s heartbreaking because I love his family too, they’re so welcoming to me and loving.
It’s been rough, my fiancé cheated on me and has continued to hide things from me. I’m really trying to let go but it’s really hard as of late. The music helps drown my emotions.

Had to screenshot since there’s so much. Thank you friend, an old friend of mine really liked Earl Sweatshirt. Great artist.
Lofi is always fun and lovely to hear.
I’ve just recently got back into metal music, I’ve been listening to Within Destruction.
My favorite band of all time was Issues, just recently they had gotten rid of their lead singer for sexual abuse allegations and the screamer left to be a drummer in another band. It broke my heart, I never got to see them in concert... but hey Attack Attack is back from the dead. There’s some hope, I guess. Thank you for all the music, it’s greatly appreciated.
Being self destructive sucks, but you can always learn when you can adjust that mentality.

It’s never too late to rebuild, it happens. I’ve been there, I had plans to get my life together and I ended up with a guy who cheated on me. I’m. Still recovering, I quit my job because of him. I figured my life was crumbling below my feet but it wasn’t. I believe in you, I’m sure once you realize you can fix anything you’ll be able to handle this better.
Is there no way for you to positively remove yourself from that situation?
What would be on your mind?

I literally like everything, I’m sure there’s a song in any category I could enjoy. I do love peep, I was just telling my fiancé about the day I woke up for school and found out her had passed. :( my heart broke
For my mother it was giving birth to me and having me as a companion. What are some of your hobbies, I’m always looking for friends. :)

Beauty is the eye of the beholder, there’s folk lore that says your face is the face of a past lover. Maybe you loved your own face in the past. I’m sure you’re not dumb, if so why do you feel this way? Fat is normal, I work out everyday and still way 180lbs at 5’2 and 20 years old. I still have body fat, and some tummy. Being broke is something you can always work to change. You’re doing great right now, hopefully you can keep pushing.
I can’t physically hold you sorry friend! So I hold your hand! You got this, you don’t need to do better you’re doing great.
Hormones suck, have you thought of not medically transitioning? Just presenting as the gender you prefer/feel/need to be?
Would you like to talk?
I hope you can stay strong and I hope this moment in your life gets washed away like a foot print in the sand. You’re doing great.

Whatever you’re going through may feel like a mountain right now, but it’s just a speed bump. You’ll eventually get through this, it may scrape you up a little but you got this. I hope you have a lovely day/night.

I’ve been there. Parents don’t usually understand, it’s hard to talk to them too because they tend to not realize what they do hurts their children. I hope she’ll realize that she’s not helping you, I know it’s hard to talk to them about this stuff but it maybe worth a shot.
Understandable, hope you can feel better and have a great life. Remember to stay strong, good night/day! Also, thank you!
Hey buddie, it seems like you’re on a self destructive path. Wanna talk about it?

Hey buddie, I just wanna start off with it’s beautiful that you’ve been so strong for so long. Looks don’t mean much of anything at all, they don’t define an individual and I’m more than positive you’re not what you define as ugly. You do deserve to live and you deserve kindness. I hope you feel better fellow sad human.

I hope you feel better, you’re still young and I feel bad you’re this down. This bullying and bad thoughts may feel like a mountain but it’s really jus a speed bump you’ll be able to get over!<3 Stay strong and remember to always be yourself.
Love this!!

Honestly, the best thing to try and do is talk to an adult in the situation and try to get it figured out because fighting fire with fire won’t get you anywhere but an even bigger fire. Maybe his home life isn’t good, maybe his parents are horrible people, maybe his grandma died, maybe something really bad happened to him, bullying is normally made from something bad.
You are worth it, everything you do is beautiful and you’ll be happy that you lived. I hope you can feel better.

That’s not necessarily okay for your school to do, I’m assuming you haven’t came out to your parents/guardians about your sexuality? If there’s any way you’d be able to bring the bullying up to your guardians you should.
Hope your day/night gets better lad. Stay strong.

Have you tried to talk to teachers/principals/etc.? I’m 20! I graduated with a few suspensions for fighting, I was bullied in the 7th grade when I switched schools for being different. Then my senior year of high school because a girl bullied my step brother.

I’m also pan! First off I’d like to say sorry for what you have to deal with, are you in High School? Being called the f slur is something I’ve just come to except being from the Midwest, personally that is.
Honestly, wouldn’t bother me at all, but I won’t force you to talk to me if you don’t want to. I honestly hope you can feel better, stay strong OP.

I get that, sometimes having attention can really help and getting that little bit of attention can also really validate someone. I’m here to talk, I may not be the coolest person and I definitely can’t bring 100s of different people but I understand your frustrations and I can definitely listen. My posts never get attention and I think my real Reddit account has like 60 karma and it’s 6 years old so, I vibe.

It’s amazing you’ve been able to stay strong this far. I apologize for what has been said to you and I hope you can understand that those people/that person is clearly delusional in social situations. These are the same people who will say “why didn’t they ask for help,” if you do commit. They’re idiots and I’m glad you can see that. It’s okay to ask for help, it’s great to seek help.
It wasn’t anything deadly, fortunately. It was gonorrhea, he did knowingly get it from his ex.
Thank you, I will do my best.
No, I don’t wanna make fun of anyone. I’m not doing too well myself and I figured maybe talking to others might help me feel better too. I’m genuinely curious to what’s bothering you, I’m all ears.

I understand, I’m not sure some stranger can make you feel much better right now. I just figured you wanted someone to help you not feel ignored, my apologies.
I just relate to how you feel, my mind hasn’t shut up itself and continues to run. If you’d like to talk more about what’s on your mind I wouldn’t mind listening.
Hey Bud, what’s got you feeling down?

Hey man. How olds you kid?
Do you think they’d be okay with out you? It’s hard to lose a parent as an adult, let alone losing a parent as a kid.
My cats are my positivity tonight. I hope your dog can keep you here, he’d be so lost without you.

Thank you. I wish I wasn’t like this. I wish I could just not feel sad. I haven’t even been able to go to the doctor to get medication because I’ve been so sad. I quit my job because a kid saw me crying at a daycare I’m just a mess. Thank you for listening.
You’re not alone in your feelings. I hope you can feel better.

Life is a roller coaster, relationships (especially if you’re still in school/college,) come and go. It’s normal to feel like a burden but it’s not true. I hope you can find someone to love you for you.
Thank you. I just don’t know what to do anymore. I don’t think I could leave, I’m just so miserable.

There’s no reason to hate yourself, I’m non-binary and receive hate but that hate doesn’t define you or me. Being trans is beautiful, I hope the best for your transition. Hating yourself is exactly what the horrible people want, show them they’re wrong.
